text: Implemented observation_index(), observations(), events(), observation_confounds(), partition_hierarchy(), study(), study_axis() and study_capabilities() over existing lazy source/domain contracts. Unequal runs, timing units/coverage, reordered confounds, censor lineage and nesting validate per partition; misalignment/timing failures are classed refusals with reasons/remedies; metadata construction performs zero lazy neural reads; no sampling, independence or generalization default exists. Full suite passes with four opt-in scale skips.
